name: Geometrize Importer
description: Imports Geometrize JSON into the editor. Supports every shape type: rectangle, rotated rectangle, triangle, ellipse, rotated ellipse, circle, line and quadratic bezier.

square-id.name: Square object ID
square-id.description: Object ID used for rectangles, rotated rectangles, lines and beziers. Should be a plain solid 1x1 block (30 units).

circle-id.name: Circle object ID
circle-id.description: Object ID used for circles and ellipses. Should be a solid filled circle that is 1x1 block (30 units) across.

triangle-id.name: Triangle object ID
triangle-id.description: Object ID used for triangles. Must be a solid right-isosceles triangle that fills a 1x1 block (30 units). Each Geometrize triangle is built from two of these.

triangle-right-angle-right.name: Triangle right angle on the right
triangle-right-angle-right.description: ON if the right angle of your triangle object is in its bottom-right corner, OFF if it is in the bottom-left corner. If imported triangles look mirrored or broken, flip this.

units-per-pixel.name: Units per image pixel
units-per-pixel.description: Size of one Geometrize pixel in GD units. A block is 30 units, so 0.5 makes a 400px-wide image about 200 units wide.

line-thickness.name: Line thickness (image pixels)
line-thickness.description: Thickness used for Geometrize line and bezier shapes.

bezier-segments.name: Bezier segments
bezier-segments.description: How many straight segments each quadratic bezier is approximated with.

color-channels.name: Color channels to use
color-channels.description: Geometrize colors are merged into at most this many color channels (k-means). More channels = better colors, but uses more of the 999 available.

start-channel.name: First color channel
start-channel.description: The first color channel ID to use. The mod overwrites these channels, so pick a free range.

import-background.name: Import background rectangle
import-background.description: Geometrize's first shape is a full-image background rectangle. Turn this off to skip it.

shape-limit.name: Shape limit (0 = all)
shape-limit.description: Only import the first N Geometrize shapes. Useful for testing and keeping object counts down.
